srList.sentence: Patients and Methods This prospective, randomized, controlled clinical study included 40 patients (40 eyes) who had unregulated eye pressure despite taking maximal antiglaucoma pharmacotherapy, i.e., patients with refractory glaucoma, treated at the Eye Department, Clinical Center of Vojvodina, Novi Sad, Serbia, between January 2016 and June 2019.
